# costgraph_integration (Data Source)

Look up an existing CostGraph integration by its connection UUID. Returns common connection metadata without credentials. The API key must have access to the connection's tenant. A missing connection returns an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connection_uuid" {
  type = string
}

data "costgraph_integration" "existing" {
  id = var.connection_uuid
}

output "connection_name" {
  value = data.costgraph_integration.existing.display_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Lowercase connection UUID from CostGraph, rather than the fpc_ ingestion ID.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection identifier.
- `display_name` (String) Connection name shown in CostGraph.
- `provider_account_id` (String) Provider billing account identifier.
- `provider_name` (String) Canonical provider name.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant that owns the connection.
